multiclicker.module.clicker.attack.desc: Presses the attack key: hits mobs or breaks blocks.
multiclicker.module.clicker.attack_key.d: Turns this channel on and off while you play. Click, then press a key; right-click removes it.
Click — separate presses. Hold — keeps the key held down (mining, eating, shield, bow).
Interval — ticks between clicks. CPS — clicks per second; fractions of a tick carry over, so 12 CPS is kept on average.
multiclicker.module.clicker.attack_inter: Ticks between clicks (20 ticks = 1 second). With cooldown sync it is the delay after the weapon is fully charged.
multiclicker.module.clicker.attack_cps.d: 1 to 20 (at most one click per tick). With cooldown sync it is the rate once the weapon is fully charged.
How long the key stays down. Forever — never release it.
multiclicker.module.clicker.attack_jitte: Adds 0…N random ticks to every delay so the rhythm is not perfectly even.
How the random delay is spread. Even — any value from 0 to N. Bell curve — mostly around N/2, a steady rhythm. Natural — mostly short with a rare longer pause, like a person.
multiclicker.module.clicker.use.desc: Presses the use key: uses items, places blocks, interacts.
multiclicker.module.clicker.use_key.desc: Turns this channel on and off while you play. Click, then press a key; right-click removes it.
multiclicker.module.clicker.use_mode.des: Click — separate presses. Hold — keeps the key held down (mining, eating, shield, bow).
multiclicker.module.clicker.use_rate.des: Interval — ticks between clicks. CPS — clicks per second; fractions of a tick carry over, so 12 CPS is kept on average.
multiclicker.module.clicker.use_cps.desc: 1 to 20 (at most one click per tick).
multiclicker.module.clicker.use_hold.des: How long the key stays down. Forever — never release it.
multiclicker.module.clicker.use_jitter.d: Adds 0…N random ticks to every delay so the rhythm is not perfectly even.
multiclicker.module.clicker.use_jitter_t: How the random delay is spread. Even — any value from 0 to N. Bell curve — mostly around N/2, a steady rhythm. Natural — mostly short with a rare longer pause, like a person.
multiclicker.module.clicker.jump_key.des: Turns this channel on and off while you play. Click, then press a key; right-click removes it.
multiclicker.module.clicker.jump_mode.de: Click — separate presses. Hold — keeps the key held down (mining, eating, shield, bow).
multiclicker.module.clicker.jump_rate.de: Interval — ticks between clicks. CPS — clicks per second; fractions of a tick carry over, so 12 CPS is kept on average.
multiclicker.module.clicker.jump_cps.des: 1 to 20 (at most one click per tick).
multiclicker.module.clicker.jump_hold.de: How long the key stays down. Forever — never release it.
Adds 0…N random ticks to every delay so the rhythm is not perfectly even.
multiclicker.module.clicker.jump_jitter_: How the random delay is spread. Even — any value from 0 to N. Bell curve — mostly around N/2, a steady rhythm. Natural — mostly short with a rare longer pause, like a person.
multiclicker.module.clicker.attack_coold: Attacks only when the weapon is fully charged, for maximum damage. Turn off on 1.8-style PvP servers.
multiclicker.module.clicker.attack_targe: Entities — only creatures allowed by the target filter. Entities + blocks — also break blocks. Anything — click even into the air.
multiclicker.module.clicker.pause_while_: Does not attack while you eat, drink, block with a shield or draw a bow.
multiclicker.module.clicker.looting_swap: When the next hit will kill the target, switches to the hotbar weapon with the best Looting, waits for it to charge, hits and switches back.
Waits after turning on, giving you time to aim.
multiclicker.module.clicker.background.d: Keeps the game running when its window is not focused, so you can use other programs while farming. Restored when the mod turns off.
Mouse movement does not turn the camera while the mod is on, so the aim cannot drift.
multiclicker.module.clicker.attack_limit: Turns the mod off after this many attacks.
multiclicker.module.clicker.time_limit.d: Turns the mod off after this many minutes.
multiclicker.module.target_filter.desc: Which creatures the clicker is allowed to attack
multiclicker.module.target_filter.neutra: Endermen, zombified piglins, wolves, bees, iron golems…
Boats, minecarts, armor stands, end crystals.
multiclicker.module.target_filter.ignore: Skips baby animals and mobs — handy on breeding farms.
Skips mobs with a name tag.
Skips tamed animals: wolves, cats, parrots, horses…
multiclicker.module.safety.desc: Stops or leaves the server when you are in danger
multiclicker.module.safety.action.desc: Stop — turn the mod off. Disconnect — also leave the server.
multiclicker.module.safety.health.desc: Triggers when health drops to this level.
multiclicker.module.safety.on_damage.des: Triggers as soon as you take damage.
multiclicker.module.safety.player_radius: Triggers when another player comes this close.
multiclicker.module.offhand.desc: Keeps the most useful item in the offhand
multiclicker.module.offhand.totem_health: Highest priority. Puts a Totem of Undying in the offhand at or below this health. 100% — always keep one there.
Puts the best safe food in the offhand when the hunger bar is at or below this value, until you are full. With auto eat on, food is only taken from the backpack: the hotbar food stays for auto eat.
multiclicker.module.offhand.torch_with_p: Puts a torch in the offhand while you hold a pickaxe.
multiclicker.module.offhand.shield.desc: When nothing above is needed, keeps a shield in the offhand.
multiclicker.module.auto_eat.desc: Eats food from the hotbar when you get hungry
multiclicker.module.auto_eat.hunger.desc: Starts eating when the hunger bar is at or below this value (20 is full). The food is eaten directly: a chest, door or villager in front of you is never touched.
multiclicker.module.auto_eat.avoid_harmf: Never eats rotten flesh, spider eyes, raw chicken, pufferfish, suspicious stew…
multiclicker.module.auto_eat.keep_valuab: Never eats golden apples and golden carrots.
multiclicker.module.auto_fish.desc: Reels in on a bite and casts the rod again (rod in either hand)
multiclicker.module.auto_fish.reaction.d: Delay between the bite and reeling in.
multiclicker.module.auto_fish.jitter.des: Random extra delay for a more natural rhythm.
Casts the rod again after a catch.
multiclicker.module.auto_fish.timeout.de: Pulls the hook in and casts again if nothing bites for this long.
multiclicker.module.auto_fish.protect_ro: Stops when the rod has this much durability left.
multiclicker.module.auto_fish.catch_limi: Turns the mod off after this many catches.
multiclicker.module.auto_farm.desc: Harvests ripe crops and plants them again
multiclicker.module.auto_farm.range.desc: How far around you to harvest. Under crosshair — only the crop you look at.
multiclicker.module.auto_farm.replant.de: Plants wheat, carrots, potatoes, beetroots and nether wart again, from the offhand or the hotbar.
multiclicker.module.anti_afk.desc: Small random actions so the server does not kick you
multiclicker.module.anti_afk.rotate.desc: Turns the camera a little and back. The clicker may miss for a moment.
multiclicker.module.auto_walk.jump_obsta: Jumps when walking into a block.
multiclicker.module.hotbar_refill.desc: Refills used-up hotbar stacks and swaps worn tools
multiclicker.module.hotbar_refill.refill: When the last item of a hotbar stack is used (a block placed, food eaten) or a tool breaks, the same item is moved in from the inventory.
Tops a stack up from the inventory once it runs down to this many items. When empty — only after it is used up.
multiclicker.module.hotbar_refill.replac: Swaps the tool or weapon in your hand for a spare from the inventory before it breaks, so a tool with Mending is kept.
multiclicker.module.hotbar_refill.tool_d: Durability left at which the tool is swapped out.
multiclicker.module.inventory_cleaner.de: Throws junk items out of the inventory
multiclicker.module.inventory_cleaner.it: Items to throw out, one stack at a time.
multiclicker.module.inventory_cleaner.ke: Never throws items from the hotbar.
multiclicker.module.mining.desc: When the attack clicker is allowed to break blocks
multiclicker.module.mining.filter_mode.d: Whitelist — break only listed blocks. Blacklist — never break listed blocks.
multiclicker.module.mining.stop_when_ful: Does not break blocks when there is no free slot for the drops.
Stops breaking blocks when the held tool has this much durability left.
multiclicker.module.auto_tool.desc: Picks the fastest hotbar tool for the block
multiclicker.module.auto_tool.switch_bac: Returns to the previous slot after mining.
multiclicker.module.auto_tool.protect_to: Skips tools with this much durability left or less.
multiclicker.module.hud.show_inactive.de: Keeps the panel visible while the mod is off.
multiclicker.module.hud.show_profile.des: Shows the loaded profile on the panel.
multiclicker.module.hud.show_stats.desc: Clicks per second, attacks, kills and session time.
multiclicker.module.highlight.desc: Highlights the creature the clicker is about to hit
multiclicker.module.highlight.style.desc: Outline, filled box or a glow outline (like the Glowing effect).
multiclicker.module.highlight.only_when_: Highlights targets only while the mod is on.
multiclicker.module.notifications.desc: Messages when something needs your attention
Above the hotbar, in the chat (stays visible while you are away), or both.
Plays a chime with each notification.
multiclicker.module.notifications.stoppe: Shows why the mod stopped by itself (safety, limits, rod protection) where chosen above.
multiclicker.module.notifications.invent: When the last free inventory slot is taken.
multiclicker.module.notifications.tool_d: When the item in your hand has this much durability left.
multiclicker.module.notifications.ran_ou: When the last item in your hand is used up or a tool breaks and nothing replaced it.
multiclicker.module.notifications.no_foo: When auto eat wants to eat but finds no food it may eat.
multiclicker.module.notifications.fish_c: After every catch of auto fish.
multiclicker.module.notifications.player: When another player comes this close. Unlike safety, the mod keeps working.
multiclicker.module.interface.desc: Accent color and feedback of the mod
multiclicker.module.interface.accent.des: Color of the menu and HUD accents.
multiclicker.module.interface.toggle_sou: Plays a click when the mod is turned on or off.
multiclicker.module.interface.toggle_mes: Shows a message above the hotbar when the mod is turned on or off.
multiclicker.gui.title: MultiClicker
multiclicker.gui.hint.value: Click a number to type an exact value · Right-click — reset
multiclicker.gui.hint.keys: Click the keyboard icon on a module to give it a hotkey
multiclicker.gui.hint.search: Type to search · Tab — next category
multiclicker.gui.module_key: Hotkey for %s: click, then press a key or a side mouse button. Right-click removes it, Esc cancels.
multiclicker.gui.list.unknown: Added %s, but the game has no such id
multiclicker.gui.list.no_item: Hold an item in your main hand
multiclicker.gui.profiles.name: Profile name
multiclicker.gui.profiles.error: Could not access the profile file, see the log
multiclicker.gui.profiles.import.desc: Adds a profile copied with ⧉ from the clipboard. The name field names it if it has no name.
multiclicker.gui.profiles.copy_current.d: Copies the current settings to the clipboard as a line of text to share.
multiclicker.gui.profiles.import_invalid: The clipboard holds no MultiClicker profile
multiclicker.gui.profiles.copied_current: Current settings copied to the clipboard
multiclicker.gui.profiles.key.desc: Hotkey that loads this profile while you play. Click, then press a key; right-click removes it.
multiclicker.gui.profiles.copy.desc: Copy this profile to the clipboard to share it
multiclicker.gui.profiles.server.no_worl: Join a world or a server to load this profile there by itself
multiclicker.gui.profiles.server.add: Load this profile by itself on %s
multiclicker.preset.mob_farm.desc: Hits hostile and neutral mobs on full charge, eats by itself, anti-AFK.
multiclicker.preset.mining.desc: Holds attack to break blocks, picks the best tool, stops when the inventory is full.
multiclicker.preset.fishing.desc: Auto fishing with auto eat and anti-AFK.
multiclicker.preset.farming.desc: Harvests and replants crops around you, refills the hotbar and eats by itself. Add Auto Walk to go along a row.
multiclicker.preset.defaults.desc: Restores the default settings (interface, HUD and hotkeys are kept).
multiclicker.message.welcome: %s opens the settings, %s starts and stops.
multiclicker.message.module_error: error in module %s — see the log
multiclicker.message.rod_protected: the fishing rod is almost broken
multiclicker.notify.no_food: hungry, but there is no food in the inventory
modmenu.summaryTranslation.multiclicker: Auto clicker with helpers for AFK farms, mining and fishing.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.multiclic: Configurable auto clicker for attack, use and jump, with helpers for AFK farms, mining, farming and fishing: target filter, Looting finishing blow, auto eat, smart offhand, auto tool, hotbar refill, auto farm, auto fish, anti-AFK, safety stop, hotkeys, shareable profiles, HUD and target highlight.
